description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) command for viewing logs of agent nodes in the AgentField system. It defines the 'logs' command using Cobra, handling options for following the logs in real-time or displaying the last lines, and includes logic to read registry files, locate log files, and invoke system 'tail' commands.

classes.name: LogViewer
classes.description: Handles the logic for viewing agent node logs, including following logs in real-time or tailing the last lines, and retrieving log file paths from the registry.

methods.name: NewLogsCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Cobra command for viewing logs, with flags for follow and tail options.

methods.name: ViewLogs
methods.description: Displays the logs for a specified agent node, either following live logs or tailing last few lines, based on user options.

methods.name: tailLogs
methods.description: Executes the 'tail' command to show the last N lines of a log file.

methods.name: followLogs
methods.description: Executes the 'tail -f' command to follow the log file in real-time.
